items.description: Items is the list of IntegrationTargets.

listResponseMeta.description: ListResponseMeta is common information about the list.

IntegrationTargetList.title: Integration Target List

status.description: Status is the current status of the IntegrationTarget.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.title: Integration Target
octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.description: IntegrationTarget is a named and reusable destination inside an Integration (e.g. a Slack channel or a Jira project). It keeps the provider-specific identifiers out of the access Policies which only refer to the Target by its reference.

integrationRef.description: IntegrationRef is the reference of the Integration that the Target belongs to. Required.

slack.description: Slack sets the Slack specific options.

jira.description: Jira sets the Jira specific options.

webhook.description: Webhook sets the generic webhook specific options.

projectKey.description: ProjectKey is the key of the Jira project that the issues are created in. Required.

issueTypeName.description: IssueTypeName is the name of the Jira issue type of the created issues. It defaults to `Task`.

approveStatus.description: ApproveStatus is the name of the Jira status which, once an issue transitions to it, submits an approving decision to the Cluster. The decision is read from the status transition of the webhook event itself and not from the current status of the issue. It is only used by the INTERACTIVE review Surfaces. It must differ from `rejectStatus`.

rejectStatus.description: RejectStatus is the name of the Jira status which, once an issue transitions to it, submits a rejecting decision to the Cluster. The decision is read from the status transition of the webhook event itself and not from the current status of the issue. It is only used by the INTERACTIVE review Surfaces. It must differ from `approveStatus`.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.title: Jira
octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.description: Jira sets the Jira specific options

channelID.description: ChannelID is the ID of the Slack channel (i.e. `C...`) that the presentations are delivered to. Required.

mentionUserGroupID.description: MentionUserGroupID is the ID of the Slack user group (i.e. `S...`) that is mentioned in the delivered presentations.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.title: Slack
octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.description: Slack sets the Slack specific options

url.description: URL overrides the URL of the Integration for this Target.

name.description: Name is an opaque label that is included in the delivered payloads so that the receiving system can route them.

octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.description: Webhook sets the generic webhook specific options

octelium.api.main.access.v1.IntegrationT.description: Status is the current status of the IntegrationTarget

page.description: Page is the page number. Starts with zero.

itemsPerPage.description: ItemsPerPage is the number of items per page.

totalCount.description: TotalCount is the total count of items that can be obtained.

hasMore.description: HasMore shows whether a next page is available

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ListResponseMe.title: List Response Meta
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ListResponseMe.description: ListResponseMeta is the pagination information that is common to every List response.

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
